### BLOCKER 1 — `campaign-stop-confidence-per-claim` (campaign_state.py:523-532)
`check_stop`'s confidence-target rule stops the campaign when ANY single ingested child's per-claim confidence tag ranks >= target. Clean-result confidence is PER-CLAIM, not per-question; most children land HIGH on a narrow claim, so a default-target (HIGH) campaign stops after its first ingest. Fix: add nullable `stop.current_confidence` (campaign-level working belief, set by the skill at each ingest from the world model), compare THAT to the target in check_stop, drop the per-row scan; update SKILL.md 1.1 step 4 and tests test_check_stop_fixed_order / test_check_stop_confidence_target_respects_rank_and_status (both currently pin the wrong semantics).

### BLOCKER 2 — `campaign-spawn-before-state-save` (.claude/skills/campaign/SKILL.md Step 1.4)
Step 1.4 orders: file child (task.py new) -> spawn session -> THEN update row + committed hours + save. A session crash in that window (watcher stop-then-respawn, API-refusal kill) leaves the row `planned` with `child_task: null`; the respawned round re-files a DUPLICATE child (duplicate pod, up to per-child-cap GPU-h) and the orphan's hours never enter `gpu_hours_committed` (ledger under-counts). Reconcile (1.1) has no orphan-child cross-check against `list-children`. Fix: persist `filed` + `child_task` + committed BEFORE `spawn-issue` (then flip to `running` after), embed the DAG experiment id in the child body/title, and add a 1.1 bullet: any list-children row not matching a state `child_task` -> adopt by experiment id or post epm:failure.

### CONCERNS (verdict-body, not ledger-bound)
1. Dual budget source of truth — `spawn-campaign --budget-gpu-hours/--max-concurrent` (spawn_session.py:1211-1224) land only in the registry entry; enforcement reads campaign-state.json, initialized from frontmatter `campaign:` overrides/defaults (campaign_state.py:267-287). A user passing --budget-gpu-hours 50 gets a campaign enforcing 250.
2. Completed-campaign session leak — `_process_campaign_entry` (autonomous_session_watch.py:4813-4815) reaps `campaign-<N>.json` on the FIRST terminal tick, unmapping the session before the session-reconcile pass could ever auto-stop it; the idle session lives forever.
3. waiting-user budget under-count — an over-cap plan (the reason for the park) retains only `gpu_hours_est` committed; on user approval the row resumes with committed far below the approved plan's hours. Same family: abandon-release returns the full est even when a pod already burned hours.
4. No implementer report marker (`epm:experiment-implementation` / `epm:results`) on task #586's events.jsonl — checks live only in the commit message (ad-hoc /independent-reviewer flow; note for when this enters /issue).
